faqs.question: What is your return policy?
faqs.answer: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee on all products. Items must be returned in original condition with packaging. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days.

faqs.question: How long does shipping take?
faqs.answer: Most orders ship within 1-2 business days. Delivery typically takes 2-5 business days depending on your location. You'll receive tracking information via email.

faqs.question: Do you offer free shipping?
faqs.answer: We offer free shipping on orders over $50. For orders under $50, shipping costs $4.99.

faqs.question: Can I change my order after placing it?
faqs.answer: Orders can be modified within 2 hours of placement. Contact our support team immediately with your order number. After 2 hours, the order cannot be changed.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), PayPal, and Apple Pay.

faqs.question: Are your products covered by warranty?
faqs.answer: All electronics come with a 1-year manufacturer's warranty. Clothing and accessories have a 6-month defect warranty. Premium items may have extended coverage.

faqs.question: How do I track my order?
faqs.answer: You'll receive a tracking link via email once your order ships. You can also track orders in your account dashboard.

faqs.question: What if my item arrives damaged?
faqs.answer: Please report damaged items within 48 hours of receipt. We'll send a replacement immediately or issue a full refund at your preference.

faqs.question: Do you have a physical store?
faqs.answer: We currently operate online only. However, we have excellent customer support available 24/7 through this chat.

faqs.question: Can I get a discount for bulk orders?
faqs.answer: Yes! Orders of 10+ items receive a 10% discount. Contact our sales team for bulk pricing on larger quantities.
